versionwatch-check-now: Label of the button on [[Special:VersionWatch]] that runs a new check.
versionwatch-no-report: Shown on [[Special:VersionWatch]] when no check has run yet.
versionwatch-last-checked:
Shown above the report.

Parameters:
* $1 - date and time of the check
versionwatch-stale: Warning shown when the stored report is more than a week old.
versionwatch-attention:
Summary above the report.

Parameters:
* $1 - number of components that are outdated or no longer supported
versionwatch-attention-none: Summary above the report when nothing is outdated or unsupported.
versionwatch-section-platform: Heading for the table with MediaWiki, PHP and the database server.
versionwatch-section-extensions:
Heading for the table of extensions.
{{Identical|Extension}}
versionwatch-section-skins:
Heading for the table of skins.
{{Identical|Skin}}
versionwatch-column-installed: Table column header for the installed version.
versionwatch-column-latest: Table column header for the latest available version or commit.
versionwatch-column-note:
Table column header for the explanation of the status.
{{Identical|Details}}
versionwatch-status-current: Status of a component that is up to date.
versionwatch-status-outdated: Status of a component for which a newer version or newer commits exist.
versionwatch-status-unsupported: Status of a component whose release branch has reached end of life.
versionwatch-status-unknown:
Status of a component that could not be checked. The details column explains why.
{{Identical|Unknown}}
versionwatch-status-skipped: Status of a component that the configuration excludes from checking.
versionwatch-note-request-failed:
Parameters:
* $1 - host name, such as gerrit.wikimedia.org
* $2 - error, such as "HTTP 500" or a connection error from cURL
versionwatch-note-unknown-product: Shown for a database server type that has no release data.
versionwatch-note-eol: Shown when a release branch is unsupported but no end date is known.
versionwatch-note-commits-behind:
Parameters:
* $1 - number of commits
* $2 - branch name, such as REL1_43
versionwatch-note-only-ignored-commits:
Shown when all newer commits are from authors such as the translation bot, which do not count as updates.

Parameters:
* $1 - number of commits
versionwatch-note-no-branch:
Parameters:
* $1 - branch name, such as REL1_43
versionwatch-note-invalid-setting: Shown when the entry for an extension or skin on the settings page cannot be understood, for example after a manual edit.
versionwatch-note-no-version: Shown for an extension or skin that has neither git information nor a version number.
versionwatch-note-no-upstream-version: Shown when the upstream extension.json or skin.json has no version to compare with.
